svg.aria-label: Bar chart, log scale, p50 on an Android 17 emulator. phonedriver against plain adb and phone-harness 0.3.3. UI tree, 1,000-row list 170 times faster than adb (phone-harness 186 times); UI tree, Settings 43 times faster than adb (phone-harness 47 times); Screenshot 32 times faster than adb (phone-harness 38 times); Type 100 characters 23 times faster than adb (phone-harness 25 times); Tap, then what changed 4.8 times faster than adb (phone-harness not supported); Tap, back to back 4.4 times faster than adb (phone-harness 4.2 times); Tap, 1.5 s apart 2.4 times faster than adb (phone-harness 7.7 times).
